concerns.text: The plan proposes 1,000 block‑permutations per window and computes autocorrelations for all lags h ≤ L/2 within each permutation (e.g., up to 50,000 lags for L=10⁵). This results in on the order of 1 billion autocorrelation calculations across all windows, which is unlikely to complete within the 6 h GitHub Actions free‑tier limit using CPU‑only NumPy vectorisation. The runtime estimate of ~2.5 h appears overly optimistic and does not account for the massive per‑permutation, per‑lag computation. This makes the approach infeasible under the free‑compute constraints.
